messages:
Maria G.: FYI tenant-93 opened a ticket — after a SAML metadata update they started seeing 500s on /v1/generate and SCIM events aren't showing in audit logs. Also a billing spike for the tenant. Trace ids: tr_3f2a2b. Will paste repro below.
Alex P.: Can you paste the tenant id (confirmed) and a sample trace payload + link to logs? Also which KMS change was scheduled?
Maria G.: tenant: tenant-93-prod. sample trace: tr_3f2a2b. Logs: https://logs.redwood/tenant-93?range=1h . Note: KMS/HSM rotation was run during the morning maintenance window yesterday per change ticket CHG-2026-110.
Sudeep R.: Security note: we rotated the HSM key at 2026-03-16T02:12:10Z (key version v13). Rotation was intended to be transparent, but I'll audit key bindings and IAM after this.
Jen C.: Customer says SCIM deprovisioning events are missing from audit (users deleted but nothing in the audit index). Could be SCIM webhook auth failing post-rotation.
Alex P.: For repro can you run this from a customer environment and paste output?
Alex P.: ```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/scim/v2/Users \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"repro+1@acme.com"}'
```
Kelsey: Also capture the X-Request-Id / x-trace-id header on failing /v1/generate calls and attach any Go/Python stack snapshots from the service.
Maria G.: Failing generate call header: x-trace-id: tr_3f2a2b, response 500 body: {"error":"internal","code":500,"detail":"kvcache: decrypt failed: access denied"}
Sudeep R.: "kvcache: decrypt failed" indicates KMS Decrypt (or HSM unwrap) is being denied for the serving role on v13. Did the rotation change the IAM binding or key ACLs? I'll check key policy and HSM access list.
Jen C.: Also verify audit ingestion: retention is 90d for this customer. If events are missing today that points to ingestion or a write error rather than retention policy.
Alex P.: Short-term mitigation: rollback to previous key version (v12) for tenant-93. Admin steps: 
```
# admin
redwood-admin kms set-key --tenant tenant-93 --key-version v12
```
Maria G.: Can support perform that rollback or do we need infra/sre approval? Customer wants immediate fix.
Sudeep R.: I can perform the rollback but need oncall approval for HSM session ops. I'll open a secure session and validate policy before flipping.
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — SAML/KMS rotation impacting SCIM + API 500s. Priority: P1. https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-045
Alex P.: I'll collect full logs and produce a minimal repro using the curl above, include response headers and stack. Maria — please confirm the 2-minute maintenance window they can tolerate.
Maria G.: They can tolerate ~2m for a rollback window. Please keep me posted. :pray:
Kelsey: We should also schedule an RBAC/least-privilege review: if rotation removed kms:Decrypt for the serving principal, that's a policy/config drift issue. Add to security backlog and attach to the incident.
Sudeep R.: Agreed. I'll attach the KMS policy diff and ping eng-infra/eng-sre for IAM reconciliation.
Jen C.: Next steps checklist: 1) Capture curl output + trace headers. 2) Verify KMS key binding and HSM ACLs. 3) If necessary, rollback to v12 (with oncall). 4) Investigate audit ingestion for missing SCIM events. 5) Postmortem + RBAC policy review.
Alex P.: I'll post the repro artifacts in the incident once I have them.
Maria G.: Thanks all — I'll update the customer after we confirm the rollback plan. :thumbsup:
